title: Defect-Class Cut on Workmanship Shares — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
The defect recorded decides the defect-class cut on a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty workmanship share — a percentage of the prorated share taken off it.

| Defect on the inspection entry | Cut |
|---|---|
| tread separation | 40% of the prorated share off |
| belt shift | 40% of the prorated share off |
| bead leak | 25% of the prorated share off |
| out-of-round | nothing off |

Every part taken off the prorated share is a percentage of the prorated share worked out on its own; together they never take the workmanship share percentage below 0.

**Worked (hypothetical prorated share of 50):** tread separation — 20 off, leaving 30; bead leak — 12.5 off, leaving 37.5; out-of-round — 50.
